fields.label: City
fields.note: Repeated checkbox parameter on the search form (filter_city_* inputs).

fields.label: Country
fields.note: ISO-2 codes from the country_codes[] checkboxes.

fields.label: Category
fields.note: The form submits a 32-hex uid per category (filter_category_1_0_N value); the label sits next to each checkbox, so label -> uid mapping has to be scraped from the listing HTML.

fields.label: Remote
fields.note: Single checkbox named remote with value 'true'.

notes: https://www.pagerduty.com/careers/ redirects to careers.pagerduty.com, whose unfiltered listing is GET /jobs/search (30 rows/page, one-based ?page=N). The listing page carries a real GET form (action /jobs/search, method get) with: query (keyword box, 'Search by job title, location, department, category, etc.'), location_uids (hidden, written by the location autocomplete), category_uids[], country_codes[], states[], cities[], remote and a hidden sort field with no published option list. Results are rendered client-side after an AWS WAF challenge, so the adapter renders the page in headless Chromium; the query contract itself is the portal's own form. States[] (8 values) and the geo location_uids slider are additional controls not modelled here.
evidence: https://careers.pagerduty.com/jobs/search (GET form: query, location_uids, category_uids[], country_codes[], states[], cities[], remote, sort)
